items.title: A direct sum of injective modules over a Noetherian ring is injective
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that over a Noetherian ring a direct sum of injective modules is injective (author lemma at source lines 508-512, label lemma-sum-injective-modules). The proof (source lines 514-524) invokes the Baer criterion, uses finite generation of ideals to confine the image to finitely many summands and extends there (proof lines 514-523). The finiteness reduction is the substance. H3.
